question: Assume today is 2026-09-10. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the total container volume handled by the Port of Los Angeles in September 2026, in TEUs (twenty-foot equivalent units; loaded and empty imports and exports combined), as it will be first reported in the Port of Los Angeles's monthly cargo news release.

target.what: Total container volume (loaded + empty, imports + exports, all containerized cargo) handled by the Port of Los Angeles during September 2026, as first reported in the Port's monthly cargo news release (TEUs)
target.publisher: Port of Los Angeles (Port of Los Angeles monthly cargo news release / TEU statistics)
target.caveats: Target period is future/ongoing relative to the 2026-09-10 cutoff; September 2026 is incomplete at cutoff, so the estimate must be built from prior months, seasonality, and forward signals. Definition chosen: total TEUs = loaded imports + loaded exports + empty imports + empty exports, matching the

candidates.perspective: Port of Los Angeles published monthly TEU statistics
candidates.hypothesis: September 2026 total TEU will follow the Port's own recent monthly levels adjusted for September seasonality; the most recent months published before cutoff (through ~July/August 2026) anchor the level, and prior Septembers give the seasonal multiplier.
candidates.data_to_find: Port of LA monthly total TEU (loaded imports, loaded exports, empty imports, empty exports, total) for Jan 2024 through the latest month published before 2026-09-10; and September totals for 2023, 2024, 2025 to derive a September-to-prior-month seasonal ratio.

methods.label: m1

p16.role: Port of LA total TEU in September 2025

a1.role: change factor from September 2025 to September 2026

methods.rationale: Year-over-year route: September 2025 actual (883,053) scaled by a change factor grounded in July 2026 YoY decline (-5.82%), cumulative +1.8%, and national import trend (-1.3% to -3.9%). Central ~3% decline. Shared dependency: assumes September 2026 behaves like mid-2026 trend; failure mode is a tariff-driven discontinuity.

methods.label: m2

p1.role: Port of LA total TEU in July 2026

a2.role: September-to-July seasonal ratio of total TEU

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
